name: hotwheels-stock-checker
description: Backend stock checker for Hot Wheels across Indian platforms

scripts.check:blinkit: ts-node -e "import { checkBlinkit } from './src/platforms/blinkit'; import { config } from './src/config'; checkBlinkit(config.products[0]).then(console.log)"
scripts.check:zepto: ts-node -e "import { checkZepto } from './src/platforms/zepto'; import { config } from './src/config'; checkZepto(config.products[0]).then(console.log)"
scripts.check:firstcry: ts-node -e "import { checkFirstCry } from './src/platforms/firstcry'; import { config } from './src/config'; checkFirstCry(config.products[0]).then(console.log)"
scripts.check:amazon: ts-node -e "import { checkAmazon } from './src/platforms/amazon'; import { config } from './src/config'; checkAmazon(config.products[0]).then(console.log)"
